title: Independence of the frame
statement:
In the situation of [def-pur-frame-class], the class
$\operatorname{cl}(f)$ of [def-pur-frame-class] depends only on
the ideal of $Z$, i.e. only on the pair, not on the frame.

proof.text: Apply the local equality criterion [lem-pur-frame-class-local-equality] to the original frame classes on their fixed pullback support. It suffices to prove the local heterogeneous equality of their boundary products at each point.
At each point apply [lem-pur-frame-local-generator-chains] to obtain an affine open neighbourhood and a finite elementary chain between the restricted tuples.

Induct on this reflexive transitive chain. Reflexivity is HEq.rfl; append an edge using [lem-pur-frame-elementary-moves] and HEq.trans. Supply the resulting local equality to the criterion. The original frameClassOnPullback definition is unchanged and unfolds to its conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Seven-step corrected route factored into local generator chains (proved), elementary cohomological invariance, and local equality descent. Parent combines these by actual chain induction; no unit route is bypassed.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q85-4aceb6649 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 4 new nodes, the cited statements, the blueprint text of lem-pur-frame-independence in both snapshots and the sk-prop-a1-kummer unit record. The worker's corrections to the blueprint are valid: Smith normal form is unavailable over a non-PID local ring, the local cohomology sheaf on A^1_U is supported on Z_T so it is not Lambda_T, and a strict henselization is not an etale neighbourhood. The route stays inside the unit: the homotopy lemma follows from unit (a) or lem-pur-kunneth-supported plus localization. No tool_uses and no SGA. Checks: c=0 empty product; unit multiples via Kummer additivity and support exactness (pro-etale finite torsion); adjacent-transposition sign (-1)^{4}=1; the shear ideal holds both ways, and the s0/s1 pullbacks of V(f_i+taf_j) are correct; s^*p^*=id; bottom-degree edge map and descent on a Zariski cover; comparison on the etale fibre product. All new statements are true. Tested: the tuple lemma on c=0, c=1 (Nakayama forces a unit), (x,0) vs (0,x) and (1,0) vs (1,1); homotopy on C empty and C=X. A possible counterexample to bottom descent when local rings of B have infinite Krull dimension does not arise: smooth maps are open, so every open of Z meets a fibre over a minimal point of B, which forces c to equal the relative-dimension difference. Three repairs in fixes/: (1) E1: step 2 assumed V of finite type, which def-pur-frame-class does not require, and the second reader had narrowed the cup-functoriality and A^1-homotopy lemmas to separated finite-type schemes on that basis. Both lemmas are restored to arbitrary k-schemes (still true), their unused finite-type and proper stmt_deps are dropped, and step 2 now shrinks only to an affine open N, etale over V. (2) B3: bottom-descent pointed pure codimension to def-pur-support-cohomology, which does not define it; the meaning is now written inline, citing def-pur-frame-class. (3) E5, minor: step 4 now says why swapping two factors of A(1)^{\otimes c} is the identity (A(1) is locally free of rank one) and that the two supports are the same closed subscheme.
